title: Senior Solution Engineer
description:
**Location:** 
 Kolkata, India
   

  

**Function:** 
 DEAI Hitachi Vantara
   

  

**Requisition ID:** 
 R0136284
   

  

**Our Company**
 We're Hitachi Vantara, the data foundation trusted by the world's innovators. Our resilient, high\-performance data infrastructure means that customers \- from banks to theme parks \- can focus on achieving the incredible with data. If you've seen the Las Vegas Sphere, you've seen just one example of how we empower businesses to automate, optimize, innovate \- and wow their customers. Right now, we're laying the foundation for our next wave of growth. We're looking for people who love being part of a diverse, global team \- and who get excited about making a real\-world impact with data.
   

  

**The Team**
 We are seeking a highly skilled and adaptable
 **Solutions Engineer** 
 to bridge the gap between complex cloud infrastructure technologies and real\-world customer solutions. In this role, you will design, build, and implementation\-test cutting\-edge platform architectures that blend traditional virtualization with modern cloud\-native ecosystems.
   

  

 You will work closely with engineering teams and enterprise customers to architect, automate, and deploy resilient infrastructure stacks across bare\-metal, virtualized, and containerized environments.
   

  

**The Role**
**Architecture \& Deployment:** 
 Design and implement robust infrastructure solutions leveraging both container orchestration (Kubernetes) and traditional cloud computing platforms (OpenStack).
   

  

**Infrastructure as Code (IaC):** 
 Automate the provisioning, configuration, and management of complex environments using Terraform and Ansible to ensure repeatable, error\-free deployments.
   

  

**Hybrid Virtualization:** 
 Bridge the gap between legacy VMs and modern containers by deploying and managing KVM and Kube\-virt solutions.
   

  

**Automation \& Scripting:** 
 Write clean, maintainable Python and Bash scripts to automate routine tasks, build internal tools, and integrate disparate systems.
   

  

**Infrastructure Management:** 
 Optimize and troubleshoot core compute resources, storage architectures, and networking layers to ensure high availability and performance.
   

  

**Technical Consultation:** 
 Act as a trusted technical advisor to stakeholders, translating complex infrastructure requirements into scalable engineering designs.
   

  

**What You'll Bring**
 Containerization \& Virtualization
   

  

**Kubernetes:** 
 Deep, production\-grade experience with K8s orchestration, architecture, and ecosystem tools.
   

  

**OpenStack:** 
 Proven track record of deploying, configuring, and managing OpenStack components.
   

  

**KVM \& Kube\-virt:** 
 Strong understanding of kernel\-based virtual machines (KVM) and experience running traditional virtual machines inside Kubernetes clusters using Kube\-virt.
   

  

 Automation \& IaC
   

  

**Scripting:** 
 Proficiency in
 **Python** 
 and
 **Bash** 
 for system automation and tool development.
   

  

**Infrastructure as Code:** 
 Hands\-on experience with
 **Terraform** 
 (for provisioning) and
 **Ansible** 
 (for configuration management).
   

  

 Core Infrastructure
   

  

**Compute:** 
 In\-depth knowledge of physical/virtual compute resource management and optimization.
   

  

**Storage:** 
 Strong understanding of storage technologies, including
 **Storage Area Networks (SAN)** 
 and
 **local disk technologies** 
 (NVMe, SSD, RAID configurations).
   

  

**Networking:** 
 Solid foundation in networking concepts, specifically
 **Layer 2 (L2\)** 
 and
 **Layer 3 (L3\)** 
 protocols, switching, routing, and software\-defined networking (SDN).
   

  

**Preferred Qualifications**
 Relevant certifications (e.g., CKA/CKAD, OpenStack Professional, AWS/GCP/Azure Architect).
   

  

 Experience in a customer\-facing technical role (Pre\-sales, Solutions Architecture, or Professional Services).
   

  

 Strong problem\-solving skills and the ability to debug complex, distributed systems.
   

  

**About Us**
 We're a global team of innovators. Together, we harness engineering excellence and passion for insight to co\-create meaningful solutions to complex challenges. We turn organizations into data\-driven leaders that can make a positive impact on their industries and society. If you believe that innovation can inspire the future, this is the place to fulfil your purpose and achieve your potential.
   

  

**Fostering innovation through diverse perspectives**
 Hitachi is a global company operating across a wide range of industries and regions. One of the things that sets Hitachi apart is the diversity of our business and people, which drives our innovation and growth.
   

  

 We are committed to building an inclusive culture based on mutual respect and merit\-based systems. We believe that when people feel valued, heard, and safe to express themselves, they do their best work.
   

  

**How We Look After You**
 We help take care of your today and tomorrow with industry\-leading benefits, support, and services that look after your holistic health and wellbeing. We're also champions of life balance and offer flexible arrangements that work for you (role and location dependent). We're always looking for new ways of working that bring out our best, which leads to unexpected ideas. So here, you'll experience a sense of belonging, and discover autonomy, freedom, and ownership as you work alongside talented people you enjoy sharing knowledge with.
   

  

 We're proud to say we're an equal opportunity employer and welcome all applicants for employment without attention to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran, age, disability status or any other protected characteristic. Should you need reasonable accommodations during the recruitment process, please let us know so that we can do our best to set you up for success.

title: Tech S And T Product Engineer-Ardoq-NGTO-Senior-GDSF02
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Job Title** 
 \- Product Engineer \- Ardoq
   

  

**Experience** 
 : 3 to 7 years
   

  

**Employment Type** 
 : Full\-time
   

  

**Role Summary:**
 We are looking for a Product Engineer – Ardoq to develop, configure, integrate, and enhance Ardoq\-based enterprise architecture solutions. The role combines Ardoq platform engineering, Python development, API integrations, data engineering, and AI\-enabled analysis.The candidate will work with Enterprise Architects, Product Owners, Solution Architects, and technology teams to automate data ingestion, improve architecture data quality, and generate actionable insights from enterprise information.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Configure and maintain Ardoq workspaces, metamodels, components, references, fields, views, surveys, and permissions.
* Model applications, business capabilities, technologies, integrations, data flows, risks, and technical debt.
* Develop Python utilities and services for data ingestion, transformation, validation, enrichment, and synchronization.
* Integrate Ardoq with systems such as ServiceNow, Azure DevOps, Jira, GitHub, SharePoint, Azure, AWS, and other enterprise platforms.
* Build and maintain REST API integrations using JSON, HTTPS, authentication tokens, and service accounts.
* Apply AI and Large Language Models to analyze enterprise data, identify technical debt, classify findings, summarize issues, and generate recommendations.
* Develop and maintain AI prompts, response schemas, validation rules, and guardrails.
* Implement scheduled imports, data mappings, reconciliation, error handling, logging, and monitoring.
* Create Ardoq dashboards, visualizations, reports, and stakeholder\-specific architecture views.
* Support application portfolio management, technology lifecycle management, capability mapping, and application rationalization.
* Investigate and resolve integration, platform, access, AI\-output, and data\-quality issues.
* Prepare technical designs, integration specifications, operational runbooks, and user documentation.


**Must\-Have Skills:**
* 3 to 7 years of experience in product engineering, enterprise architecture tooling, integration development, or platform engineering.
* Hands\-on experience of Ardoq workspaces, metamodels, components, references, fields, visualizations, surveys, and integrations.
* Strong Python programming skills, including API clients, data processing, automation, and error handling.
* Experience with REST APIs, JSON, HTTPS, OAuth 2\.0, API tokens, and integration troubleshooting.
* Experience with AI services such as Azure OpenAI or equivalent enterprise LLM platforms.
* Knowledge of Retrieval\-Augmented Generation, embeddings, vector search, AI agents, and prompt evaluation.
* Experience with Python frameworks and libraries such as FastAPI, Pydantic, Pandas, and Pytest.
* Experience with data transformation, validation, mapping, synchronization, and reconciliation.
* Understanding of business, application, data, integration, and technology architecture.
* Practical knowledge of AI and LLM concepts, including prompt engineering, structured outputs, grounding, and response validation.
* Experience using Git and standard software\-development practices such as code reviews, testing, and version control.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, documentation, and communication skills.


**Nice\-to\-Have Skills:**
* Experience integrating Ardoq with ServiceNow CMDB, Azure DevOps, Jira, GitHub, SharePoint, Azure, or AWS.
* Knowledge of PostgreSQL, SQL, data modelling, and database integration.
* Experience with Application Portfolio Management and Technology Portfolio Management.
* Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, AKS, and cloud\-native application deployment.
* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions.
* Experience with Postman, Swagger, OpenAPI, Power BI, and API\-management platforms.
* Exposure to technical debt assessment, technology risk, lifecycle tracking, and application rationalization.
* Familiarity with Ardoq ShiftX and business process modelling.


**Education:**
 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline. Equivalent relevant experience may also be considered.
   

  

**Certifications(Added Advantage):**
* Ardoq Academy or Ardoq Partner certification
* Microsoft Azure AI Engineer Associate


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Team Lead – Software Engineering
description:
**Role Overview**
 We are seeking a Team Lead to build and lead a team of software engineers developing a strategically important cloud\-based platform that enables customers to check and improve the accuracy of their X\-Rite color measurement devices.
   

  

 This is a player\-coach role, combining hands\-on software development with technical leadership and people management. The role focuses on enabling team effectiveness, technical excellence, cloud\-native architecture, and continuous improvement in a global engineering environment.
   

  

 The team owns a modern web application built with TypeScript, React, Redux, HTML, CSS, AWS, Lambda, Node.js, and serverless technologies, as well as a companion Qt/C\+\+ desktop application responsible for collecting and managing data that is integrated into the cloud platform.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Build, lead, and develop a high\-performing team of software engineers
* Hire, onboard, motivate, and coach team members, fostering engagement, growth, and a strong team culture
* Contribute hands\-on to software development, including design, implementation, code reviews, and technical problem solving — leveraging AI throughout the software development lifecycle
* Provide technical leadership and guide architectural decisions for both the cloud platform and associated desktop applications in collaboration with global engineering teams (US, Switzerland, India, Germany, Netherlands, North Macedonia)
* Own and evolve scalable, secure, and maintainable cloud\-native architectures on AWS
* Drive the evolution of frontend and backend systems, ensuring high performance, reliability, usability, and security
* Collaborate closely with product management, UX, QA, data engineering, and application support teams to deliver customer value
* Facilitate Agile ways of working (Scrum/Kanban), supporting effective planning, execution, prioritization, and delivery
* Establish and continuously improve software engineering practices, including testing, CI/CD, cloud operations, observability, security, and effective usage of AI
* Ensure seamless integration between cloud services and desktop applications that contribute data to the platform
* Work closely with global stakeholders across India, Europe, and the US to align technical direction with product strategy
* Drive a culture of continuous improvement, innovation, accountability, and engineering excellence


**Required Qualifications \& Professional Knowledge**
* 8\+ years of relevant experience in software engineering
* 3\+ years of experience leading software engineering teams
* Strong hands\-on experience building and maintaining modern web applications
* Several years of experience with TypeScript, JavaScript, React, Redux, HTML, and CSS
* Strong backend development experience with Node.js and TypeScript
* Experience designing and operating cloud\-native solutions on AWS or Azure
* Solid understanding of serverless architectures and services such as AWS Lambda, API Gateway, and related cloud technologies
* Experience designing scalable distributed systems and defining application architectures
* Ability to analyze customer and business requirements and translate them into robust technical solutions
* Experience establishing engineering best practices including testing strategies, CI/CD, code quality, monitoring, and security
* Solid understanding of modern web application architecture and software design principles
* Experience collaborating with UX, Product Management, QA, and other engineering disciplines
* Ability to collaborate effectively with global, cross\-functional teams
* Solid understanding of the end\-to\-end software development lifecycle
* Experience working in Agile environments (Scrum and/or Kanban)
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English
* Willingness to travel (10%)


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience leading teams developing cloud\-native SaaS or enterprise software platforms
* Experience with AWS services beyond Lambda and API Gateway, such as RDS, DynamoDB, S3, CloudWatch
* Experience with DevOps, Infrastructure as Code, and cloud automation
* Experience working with data\-intensive applications, analytics platforms, or data pipelines
* Experience working in geographically distributed teams


**Nice to Have**
* Knowledge of desktop software development using C\+\+ and Qt
* Experience integrating desktop, edge, or device\-connected applications with cloud services
* Knowledge of color management, measurement systems, or hardware\-connected software solutions


**Education \& Experience**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
* :5\+ years of experience delivering and evolving commercial software products throughout their lifecycle
* Experience balancing technical leadership, people leadership, and hands\-on software development responsibilities


**Personal Attributes**
* Strong ownership mindset and ability to balance hands\-on work with leadership responsibilities
* Passion for building high\-performing engineering teams and developing people
* Collaborative and pragmatic approach in a cross\-functional, global environment
* High learning agility and enthusiasm for modern software engineering practices, cloud technologies, and AI\-assisted development
* Ability to make sound technical and organizational decisions in a fast\-paced environment
* Effective communicator capable of aligning stakeholders across multiple functions and regions


 Ability to operate effectively in a distributed team with partial timezone overlap (India ↔ US/EU)
   

  

 We recognize that people come with a wealth of experience and talent. We believe in the value of unique perspectives, and we welcome candidates from diverse backgrounds who may not meet every criterion to apply and bring their distinctive experiences to our team.
   

  

**We Offer**
* A dynamic, international, and innovative work environment.
* Exciting technical challenges and expert colleagues with decades of experience in the field.
* A position in our Bangalore office with flexibility in the time schedule and hybrid work model.
* A human\-sized organization where you'll have contact beyond the R\&D department.
* Coaching and learning opportunities at every stage of your career.
* The opportunity to work on business\-critical data platforms that support decision\-making across the company.
* Be part of building products that address real\-world challenges for customers across global industries. You'll have the opportunity to take ownership, influence technical decisions, and see your contributions create measurable business value.
* Direct collaboration with engineers, product managers, support teams, and business stakeholders across Europe, Asia, and North America.
* A culture that values technical excellence, continuous learning, and constructive challenges.
* The freedom to contribute ideas, drive improvements, and influence technical direction.
* Team leads are trusted to contribute not only technical expertise, but also vision, coaching, and leadership that help shape the future of our products and organization.


 Immerse yourself in a vibrant and dynamic workplace that spans industries such as printing, packaging, photography, graphic design, video, automotive, paints, plastics, and textiles. Join a team that thrives on pushing the boundaries of what's possible, where innovation meets impact, and cross\-functional teamwork sets us apart.
   

  

 At Veralto, we value diversity and the existence of similarities and differences, both visible and not, found in our workforce, workplace and throughout the markets we serve. Our associates, customers and shareholders contribute unique and different perspectives as a result of these diverse attributes.
   

  

**Unsolicited Assistance**
 We do not accept unsolicited assistance from any headhunters or recruitment firms for any of our job openings. All resumes or profiles submitted by search firms to any employee at any of the Veralto companies, in any form without a valid, signed search agreement in place for the specific position, approved by Talent Acquisition, will be deemed the sole property of Veralto and its companies. No fee will be paid in the event the candidate is hired by Veralto and its companies because of the unsolicited referral.

title: Senior Security Vulnerability Remediation Specialist
description:
**Overview**
**Senior Security Vulnerability Remediation Specialist**
**📍 Location:** 
 Kolkata, India
 **🏢 Work Model:** 
 Hybrid – 2 days per week in office
   

  

**About The Role**
 The Senior Security Vulnerability Remediation Specialist is a targeted Infrastructure Operations role responsible for assessing, remediating, automating, and sustaining security vulnerability fixes across Hyland's internal infrastructure. Working across servers, networks, identity platforms, cloud infrastructure, and endpoint systems, this role partners closely with Cyber Security for vulnerability identification and prioritization — while owning the execution and automation of remediation within Infrastructure\-managed systems.
   

  

**Your Role Responsibilities — Here's What You'll Do**
* Review, assess, and validate vulnerability findings from Cyber Security threat detection tools and scanners to interpret risk context, applicability, and business criticality — then determine the appropriate remediation approach.
* Execute remediation activities including patching, configuration changes, upgrades, and mitigation controls across servers, endpoints, network devices, and platforms.
* Partner with Engineering to design and implement automation and scripting that streamlines remediation using repeatable, scalable solutions that harden the environment and prevent reintroduction of vulnerabilities.
* Collaborate with Infrastructure Support and Engineering teams to identify recurring vulnerability patterns and implement protocols and procedures that prevent issues from resurfacing.
* Monitor vulnerability remediation queues, SLAs, and aging metrics to ensure commitments are met, reporting is current, and operational documentation is continuously improved.
* Influence and contribute to the development of team remediation processes, standards, and best practices — while mentoring, coaching, and providing feedback to fellow team members.


**Role Essentials**
* Experience with vulnerability scanning or risk platforms (e.g., Rapid7 or similar)
* Strong knowledge of IT infrastructure administration, including Windows Server, Active Directory, Azure Entra ID, and Linux environments
* Hands\-on experience with endpoint management, patch orchestration, or configuration enforcement tools (e.g., WSUS, MECM/SCCM, Microsoft Intune)
* Proficiency in automation and scripting languages such as PowerShell, Python, or Bash
* Experience operating within a regulated or security\-focused enterprise environment


**What We'd Like to See**
* Familiarity with infrastructure as code or automation frameworks
* Experience working in a global or follow\-the\-sun operational model
* Knowledge of cloud and virtualization platforms, including Microsoft Azure, VMware, and Hyper\-V
* Exposure to networking and security tools including firewalls (Palo Alto, Azure Firewall) and core protocols such as TCP/IP, DNS, and DHCP
* Demonstrated leadership ability with a track record of mentoring team members and influencing cross\-functional partners


**About Hyland**
 Hyland is the pioneer of the Content Innovation Cloud™, delivering ubiquitous enterprise intelligence to organizations with solutions that unlock actionable insights and drive automation. The \#HylandLife hashtag encompasses our employee\-centric culture. Our employees live our culture day in and day out by bringing their best self to work. Hyland supports them to do just that through career development resources, wellbeing programs and innovation practices. title: Performance Engineer
description:
**Project Role :** 
 Performance Engineer
   

  

**Project Role Description :** 
 Diagnose issues that an in\-house performance testing team has been unable to. There are five aspects to Performance Engineering: software development lifecycle and architecture, performance testing and validation, capacity planning, application performance management and problem detection and resolution.
   

  

**Must have skills :** 
 Laboratory Information and Execution Systems
   

  

**Good to have skills :** 
 NA
   

  

**Minimum 3 Year(s) Of Experience Is Required**
**Educational Qualification :** 
 15 years full time education
   

  

 Summary:
   

  

 As a Performance Engineer, a typical day involves investigating and resolving complex performance issues that have not been identified by the internal performance testing team. The role encompasses a broad spectrum of activities including analyzing software development processes and system architecture, validating performance through rigorous testing, planning for capacity needs, managing application performance, and swiftly detecting and addressing problems to ensure optimal system functionality. This position requires a proactive approach to maintaining and enhancing system performance across various stages of the software lifecycle, collaborating with multiple teams to deliver reliable and efficient solutions.
   

  

 Roles \& Responsibilities:
   

  

* Expected to perform independently and become an SME.
* Required active participation/contribution in team discussions.
* Contribute in providing solutions to work related problems.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to identify performance bottlenecks and recommend improvements.
* Monitor system performance metrics and generate detailed reports to support decision\-making.
* Assist in developing and refining performance testing strategies to align with project goals.
* Support junior team members by sharing knowledge and providing guidance on performance engineering best practices.


 Professional \& Technical Skills:
   

  

* Must To Have Skills: Proficiency in Laboratory Information and Execution Systems.
* Strong understanding of software development lifecycle and system architecture principles.
* Experience with performance testing tools and methodologies.
* Ability to analyze application performance data and identify root causes of issues.
* Familiarity with capacity planning and resource management techniques.
* Skilled in problem detection and resolution within complex software environments.


 Additional Information:
   

  

* The candidate should have minimum 3 years of experience in Laboratory Information and Execution Systems.
* This position is based at our Kolkata office.
* A 15 years full time education is required.

description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. **Senior Site Reliability Engineer (Senior level)**
**Description**
 Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) is a modern way of delivering IT Solutions by imbibing Software engineering principles in Service Delivery to reduce IT Risk to business, improve business resilience, attain predictability \& reliability, optimize cost of IT Infra and Ops
   

  

 A Site Reliability Engineer typically has deep software engineering experience encompassing design, build, deploy and manage / maintain an IT solution ensuring resilience, reliability, and performance.
   

  

 An SRE is a bridge between development and operations by applying a software engineering mindset to the development, deployment, and maintenance of applications to maximize system reliability \& automation, while improving efficiencies by optimizing resources
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Defining SLA/SLO/SLI for a product / service
* Engineering in resilient design and implementation practices into solutions as they go through the product life cycle
* Engineering out manual effort (Toil) through the development of automated processes and services (e.g., Automated Management of Systems, CI/CD improvements)
* Developing Observability Solutions to track, report, and measure SLA adherence
* Help Optimize Cost of IT Infra \& Operations \- FinOps
* Critical Situation management
* SOP / Runbook automation, Toil reduction
* Data Analytics \& System trend analysis


**Typical Skills And Background**
* 7\+ years of experience in software product engineering principles, processes and systems
* Hands\-on experience in Java / J2EE, one of web server (Apache Tomcat or IBM HTTP Server), one of the application servers (Tomcat/WebSphere), and any major RDBMS like Oracle
* Hands\-on experience in at least one CI\-CD (Azure DevOps, GitLab CI/CD, Jenkins) and IaC tools (Terraform, AWS CloudFormation, Ansible etc.)
* Experience in at least one cloud technology (AWS/Azure/GCP etc. and Docker, Pivotal, Kubernetes, OpenShift etc.) and its reliability tools (Azure AppInsight, CloudWatch, Azure Monitor etc.)
* Experience in Linux (RHEL) operating system performance monitoring parameters and their interpretation, commands used for monitoring
* Experience in Observability \- APM tools (Dynatrace, AppDynamics etc.), metrics / log consolidation (Splunk) and ELK Stack
* Defining NFRs and SLA/SLO/SLI agreement for a product / platform / services
* Knowledge on queuing models used, thread pools, request servicing processes etc.
* Knowledge in Web Services, SOA, ESB (DataPower), RESTFul
* Knowledge of application design patterns, J2EE application architectures, Microservices, Spring boot \& Cloud native architectures
* Proficiency in Java runtimes, Core Java, Garbage collection, JVM parameters tuning
* Experience in performance tuning on Application Servers (Tomcat/WAS)
* Experience in trouble shooting Performance / Scalability / Availability issues
* Experience in Thread dump, heap dump generation \& analysis
* Knowledge on Query tuning and database designs \& models
* Knowledge at least one automation scripting language like Python
* Mastery in collaborative software development using Git, Jira, Confluence etc.
* AI/ML \& Data Analytics knowledge and experience is a desirable
